description: ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes # https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4464#event-25212618214 --- ## 📝 Summary _What does this PR do and why?_ This PR: changes the layout of the main top navbar: - adds a search input bar that is highlighted on keyboard shortcut, and changes the suggested shortcut default text depending on the user's OS. The search logic is not yet implemented in this PR. - Adds the version number of the latest release - adds links to github and documentation, as set out in the issue guideline - Adds in a profile dropdown with: log-in username, Theme, Settings, Logout. Profile image is not yet implemented - adds unit tests for new components - Adds one string needed in PR --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [x] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------|-----------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | | | Unit tests | `make test` | | | Coverage ≥ 80% | `make coverage` | | --- ## ✅ Checklist - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [x] Tests added/updated for changes - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable) - [x] No secrets or credentials committed --- ## 📓 Notes (optional) _Screenshots, design decisions, or additional context._

commits.message:
feat: implement dark/light mode theme toggle (#4347)

* feat: implement dark/light mode theme toggle

- Add ThemeProvider with React Context API for theme management
- Create ThemeToggle component with Sun/Moon/Monitor icons
- Support three modes: light, dark, and system preference
- Persist theme preference to localStorage
- Add i18n translations for EN, ES, and PT-BR
- Integrate theme toggle in header between language switcher and user info
- Add comprehensive unit tests (16 passing)
- Add localStorage mock to test setup

Closes #[issue-number]

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>

* fix: correcting dark theme support for all components

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>

* fix: add comprehensive dark mode support across all pages and components

- Add dark mode variants to all 24 pages (Login, Dashboard, Gateways, etc.)
- Fix LanguageSwitcher component with dark mode support
- Fix authentication pages (Login, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, ChangePassword)
- Add dark:text-neutral-100 to all page headings
- Add dark:bg-neutral-700/800/900 to backgrounds
- Add dark:border-neutral-600/700 to borders
- Fix input fields with proper dark mode text and background colors
- Remove unused vi import from ThemeToggle.test.tsx
- Add non-null assertion to useTheme.test.tsx
- Format all files with Prettier

Theme persists in localStorage across sessions as requested.

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>

* fix: update icon fills to use currentColor for dark mode support

- GatewayIcon.tsx: change fill from #161616 to currentColor
- MCPIcon.tsx: change fill from black to currentColor (2 paths)
- MainNavIcon.tsx: change fill from black to currentColor (keep red accent)

Icons now inherit text color and properly support dark theme.

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>

commits.message:
fix: remove --chmod flags from Containerfile.lite for legacy Docker builder compatibility

The --chmod flag in COPY commands requires BuildKit, which may not be available
in all Docker installations. Replace with explicit chmod commands in RUN layers
for broader compatibility.

Changes:
- scripts/download-cdn-assets.sh: Use explicit chmod 0755
- run scripts: Use explicit chmod 0755 for all entrypoint scripts

This maintains the same permissions while supporting legacy Docker builder.

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>
commits.author: Vishu Bhatnagar

feat: auto-build React client with hot reload in dev mode

- Add build:watch script to client/package.json for Vite watch mode

This eliminates the need to manually run 'npm run build' in client folder
when running 'make dev'. The React app now rebuilds automatically on file
changes during development.

commits.message:
fix: restore mobile sidebar trigger in Header

The SidebarTrigger was moved inside the Sidebar component, making it
inaccessible on mobile where the sidebar is rendered in a closed Sheet.

Changes:
- Add SidebarTrigger to Header, visible only on mobile (md:hidden)
- Change Header layout from justify-end to justify-between
- Import SidebarTrigger from ui/sidebar

This fixes the mobile sidebar accessibility issue while maintaining
the desktop experience where the trigger is inside the sidebar.

Fixes requested changes in PR #4531

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>
commits.author: Vishu Bhatnagar

commits.message:
feat: add accessibility attributes to TeamSwitcher

Enhance TeamSwitcher component with comprehensive ARIA attributes for
improved screen reader support and keyboard navigation:

- Add aria-label to trigger button indicating current selection
- Add aria-haspopup and aria-expanded for dropdown state
- Add aria-hidden to decorative icons (Globe, ChevronsUpDown)
- Add aria-live="polite" to loading state for dynamic updates
- Add role="alert" to error messages for immediate announcement
- Add role="status" to empty state messages
- Add aria-label to each menu item with team name and description
- Add aria-current to indicate currently selected team

All tests passing:
- Unit tests: 8 passed
- E2E tests: 2 passed

Improves WCAG 2.1 compliance for PR #4531

Signed-off-by: Vishu Bhatnagar <vishu.bhatnagar@ibm.com>
commits.author: Vishu Bhatnagar

commits.message:
perf: optimize TeamSwitcher re-renders with memoization

Prevent unnecessary re-renders when selecting teams by memoizing
computed values and callbacks:

- Memoize teams array to prevent recreation on every render
- Memoize currentTeam lookup to avoid redundant find operations
- Use useCallback for handleSelectTeam to maintain referential equality
- Replace inline arrow functions with memoized callback

Performance improvements:
- Reduces re-renders when teams data doesn't change
- Prevents recreation of event handlers on each render
- Optimizes team lookup with dependency tracking

All tests passing:
- Unit tests: 8 passed
- E2E tests: 2 passed

Related to PR #4531
